description_en: April 12, 1861. Confederate batteries open fire on Fort Sumter in Charleston Harbor. The war begins. You command either the Union (North) or the Confederacy (South) through 4 years of the bloodiest conflict in American history. Every decision matters — from conscription to battlefield tactics to the morale of your people.
description_ru: 12 апреля 1861 года. Конфедеративные батареи открывают огонь по Форт-Самтеру в гавани Чарлстона. Война начинается. Вы командуете Союзом (Север) или Конфедерацией (Юг) на протяжении 4 лет кровопролитнейшего конфликта в американской истории. Каждое решение имеет значение — от призыва до тактики на поле боя до морали вашего народа.
historical_context_en: The United States is torn apart. Eleven Southern states have seceded to form the Confederate States of America. President Lincoln refuses to recognize the Confederacy. The first shots are fired at Fort Sumter. Both sides expect a short war. Both sides are wrong. Over 600,000 will die before it ends.
historical_context_ru: Соединённые Штаты разорваны надвое. Одиннадцать южных штатов вышли из Союза и образовали Конфедеративные Штаты Америки. Президент Линкольн отказывается признавать Конфедерацию. Первые выстрелы прозвучали у Форт-Самтера. Обе стороны ожидают короткой войны. Обе стороны ошибаются. Более 600 000 человек погибнут до её окончания.

union_advantages.industrial_capacity: Union generates +1 money per territory (factories, railroads)
union_advantages.naval_supremacy: Union starts with naval advantage, can play blockade cards from turn 5+
union_advantages.manpower_pool: Larger population = more units over time
union_advantages.blockade_mechanic: Every turn after turn 5: if Union controls >=5 ports → SIT_BLOCKADE auto-activates for Confederate -1 money, -1 supply per turn

confederate_advantages.defensive_terrain: +1 DEF bonus when defending home territory (Virginia, Tennessee, Georgia, etc.)
confederate_advantages.better_generals: Confederate commanders are cheaper and have stronger effects (Lee cost 6 vs Grant cost 5, but Lee gives +1 ATK +1 DEF to ALL units)
confederate_advantages.cavalry_raids: Confederate cavalry can raid behind lines: steal 1 resource per successful raid (Mosby, Forrest)
confederate_advantages.blockade_runners: Ships c_ship_syren and c_ship_relee can cancel blockade once per turn
confederate_advantages.home_territory_morale: Each Confederate home territory gives +0.5 morale resistance (harder to push morale below -10)

union: Capture Richmond and hold for 3 consecutive turns
Appomattox: Grant besieges Lee with Confederate resources < 30% of starting values
If war lasts until May 1865 (turn 49) — Union wins by territorial count
confederate: Capture Washington D.C. and hold for 3 consecutive turns
Survive until May 1865 (turn 49) with Richmond still in Confederate hands — negotiated peace (draw counted as Confederate win)
European Recognition: if Confederate morale >= +10 and controls >= 15 territories by turn 25 — foreign intervention wins the war

blockade.description_en: Anaconda Plan: Union naval blockade tightens. Confederate ports lose trade income.
blockade.description_ru: План Анаконда: морская блокада Союза сжимается. Конфедеративные порты теряют торговый доход.
blockade.effect_per_turn: If Union controls >= 5 ports: Confederate -1 money, -1 supply, -1 morale
blockade.counter: Confederate can play SIT_BLOCKADE_RUN or use blockade runner ships to cancel

desertion.description_en: War weariness grows. Both sides face desertion.
desertion.description_ru: Война утомляет. Обе стороны сталкиваются с дезертирством.
desertion.effect_per_turn: If any side morale < -5: roll d10, on 1 = lose 1 random unit

conscription_riots.effect: Lose 1 random unit, -2 morale, skip next draw phase
